verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only developer/API and pricing docs about AP/AR workflows, vendor payments, and general 'AI-powered spend management' language, but never mentions receipt photo capture, OCR of receipts, or email-forwarding of receipts to auto-file against transactions. Missing for 10: any mention of mobile receipt photo capture, OCR extraction, email-forward-to-receipt ingestion, or auto-matching of scanned receipts to transactions.
